name: consensus handles missing values and stable ties
rates and rejection use strict thresholds and evidence
test:
labels = [['a','a','b'], ['a','a','b'], ['b','b','a'], [None,None,'a']]
rates = agreement_rates(labels, min_labels=2)
assert rates[0] == rates[1] == 1.0 and rates[2] == 0.0
assert select_rejected_annotators(labels, threshold=0.1, min_labels=2, max_removed_fraction=0.5, min_remaining=1) == [2]

name: masking copies instead of mutating
test:
labels = [['a', 'b'], ['c', None]]
masked = mask_annotators(labels, [1])
assert masked == [['a', None], ['c', None]]
assert labels == [['a', 'b'], ['c', None]]

name: missing evidence and exclusion have explicit conservative behavior
test:
assert consensus_labels([[None, None], ['a', 'b']], excluded=[0]) == [None, 'b']
assert consensus_labels([[None, None]]) == [None]
assert agreement_rates([['a', None], ['a', None]], min_labels=2) == [1.0, 1.0]
assert select_rejected_annotators([['a', None]], threshold=1.0, min_labels=2) == []
assert agreement_rates([]) == []

name: removal budget uses stable indices and preserves minimum remaining
test:
labels = [['a', 'b', 'b', 'c', 'c'], ['a', 'b', 'b', 'c', 'c']]
assert select_rejected_annotators(labels, threshold=0.5, max_removed_fraction=0.4, min_remaining=1) == [0, 3]
assert select_rejected_annotators(labels, threshold=0.5, max_removed_fraction=1.0, min_remaining=4) == [0]
assert select_rejected_annotators(labels, threshold=0.5, max_removed_fraction=0.0, min_remaining=1) == []
